# MARCO-202 acceptance map

The accepted MARCO-197 packet1 fixtures map to the tests below. All use dummy
tasks, owners and isolated databases. Test titles include the fixture IDs.
Packet2 machine admission/journal integration is outside this plugin change.

| Fixture | Test/evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| F01     | `lanes-transfer-process`: observer pauses after membership SELECT while a second process attempts CAS; result retains version9/source4/destination7/membership3. `lanes-transfer`: rejects external/list/snapshot reads.                                                                                         |
| F02     | `bounded diagnostic observation`: absent row yields exact sentinel without insertion.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| F03     | Same test preserves the actual positive tombstone revision (1 in this fixture).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F04     | `closed database errors`: failed observe rejects instead of fabricating absence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| F05     | `two preflighted processes`, distinct IDs: one applied, one durable conflict, one event.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F06     | Same test, same ID: one immutable receipt and event. Both processes pass outer receipt miss/preflight before either transaction.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| F07     | `exact replay`: changed semantic request for used ID rejects.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| F08     | Same test reverses input property order; no additional external call or mutation.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| F09     | `F09 conflict`: source owner ABA increments lane revision and conflicts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F10     | `F10 conflict`: destination lifecycle ABA conflicts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| F11     | `F11 conflict`: wrong expected destination owner conflicts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| F12     | `F12 conflict`: wrong expected source ID conflicts independently of membership revision.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F13     | `F13 conflict`: stale unassignment loses to legacy assignment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| F14     | `exact replay` unassigns without task lookup; process `reopen and isolated restore` verifies persisted receipt after reopen.                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| F15     | SQLite trigger aborts receipt insertion; membership/clock/feed all roll back.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| F16     | Real child SIGKILL after receipt insert inside transaction, before COMMIT; reopen shows neither effect nor receipt; same-ID retry applies once.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| F17     | Real child SIGKILL inside publication callback after COMMIT, before reply; reopen/retry returns stored receipt with no external call or second event.                                                                                                                                                            |
| F18     | `pending preflight`: missing/failed first upstream attempt reconciles another same-ID committed receipt.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F19     | Same test observes not_found while first request is in flight; overlapping same-ID request commits only once.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| F20     | `closed database errors`: lookup failure rejects. Caller must retain UUID/request; caller journal integration remains packet2.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| F21     | `immutable receipts`: later membership write and >1000 events do not prune or rebuild receipt.                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| F22     | `local owner references`: observes valid local metadata despite live archived owner. Admission refusal is packet2, unsupported here.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| F23     | Same test archives/unarchives synthetic live owner; unchanged local observation proves this limitation, not absence of BB lifecycle ABA.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| F24     | `metadata allows parked/ownerless destination`: transfer applies. Active-only execution admission belongs to packet2.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| F25     | Same test allows removal from archived source.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| F26     | `F26 conflict`: real archived destination move stores conflict without membership change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| F27     | `validated no-ops`: archived same-lane, absent null and tombstone null preserve all membership/feed state and store unchanged receipts.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| F28     | `F28 conflict`: missing SQL lane is explicit missing reference; no auto-unassignment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| F29     | `lanes-api` append-migration fixture migrates old data twice with SDK helper, preserves raw rows, legacy RPC/CLI reply/increment semantics, no receipt backfill. Existing API import replay and picker/UI suites remain unchanged. First two migration bytes compared independently to base during verification. |
| F30     | `raw rows fail closed`: malformed JSON, identity mismatch, omitted fields, unsafe/zero revisions, invalid state. Strict request test rejects omitted null binding, inconsistent IDs/same-lane bindings and unsafe numbers.                                                                                       |
| F31     | `upstream missing, failed or malformed`: null, throw, undefined, missing/wrong ID leave no receipt or effect.                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| F32     | `committed publish failure`: retry reconciles receipt; feed retains exactly one event.                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| F33     | Separate child holds write transaction; parent gets actual SQLITE_BUSY, no business receipt, same-ID retry succeeds once.                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| F34     | Process suite records WAL and synchronous=2 (FULL) for isolated test DB. Restored pre-operation copy has no receipt. No power-loss or restore-global-history proof is claimed.                                                                                                                                   |
| F35     | `immutable receipts`, conflict branch: later visible changes/feed compaction never alter conflict receipt.                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| F36     | `unrelated writes`: create interleaves with observe/lookup/replay/conflict/unchanged; selected invocation contributes zero signals.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| F37     | `raw rows fail closed`: stored membership JSON null rejects, never sentinel.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| F38     | Same test: stored lane JSON null rejects, never missing/none.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| F39     | `corrupt operation rows`: JSON null, unknown version, ID/request mismatch and invalid after-membership reject lookup and replay. `contradictory full lane references` rejects incoherent same-ID lane rows.                                                                                                      |

Fault barriers, SQLite triggers, and statement interception exist only in test
helpers. Production repository classes contain no test-only crash hooks.
